body: Advisor ruling — docs stack round 2 (reviewed heads 3096@0282a960 … 3103@d2257801). Rule-once: this is the whole round; no follow-up PRs. APPROVED as-is: 3097, 3098, 3099, 3100, 3103 (their non-blocking nits are bundled below or accepted). CHANGES REQUIRED: 3096, 3101, 3102. HOW TO APPLY (important — avoids re-reviewing all eight): - Do NOT rebase or force-push. Add NEW commits on the affected branch, then propagate upward by MERGING each lower branch into the next one up (106-work -> 107-work -> ... -> 113-work), plain pushes. - Approved PRs whose own diff is unchanged get a base-only re-record; only 3096, 3101, 3102 and 3103 (which carries the bundle) get fresh reviews. 3096 (TASK-106) — fix on branch task-…-106-work: a. AC2: update the routing entries that still describe the old guide: docs/README.md:21, docs/user-guide.md:15, OVERVIEW.md:1048 (install now lives in README#install). b. build.py inline(): map what-is-aida.md -> what-is-aida.html. c. docs/showcase/index.html: drop the external-link glyph on the now-internal Getting started button. d. docs/getting-started.md: link README.md#cloning-an-existing-aida-project from the 'existing AIDA project' sentence. Accepted (no change): inline() backtick/regex ordering — latent, no current source hits it. AC3 drift check: satisfied by the shared --check in 3101 below. 3101 (TASK-111) — fix on branch task-…-111-work: a. Add `python3 docs/showcase/build.py --check` (render every generated output to memory, diff against the tracked files, non-zero exit naming each drifted file; covers getting-started.html, library.html, search-data.js and every manifest page). Wire it into .github/workflows/ci.yml next to `python3 docs/cli/verify-manual.py --static` so `make check-ci-fast` runs it. b. Search index: strip Markdown links to their text ([text](target) -> text) instead of a blanket character-class strip; keep legitimate punctuation. c. Reject duplicate manifest outputs and the reserved names library.html / index.html. d. Drop the dead .guide table / .table-scroll CSS (no table rendering exists). e. Replace the whole-page 'the source guide' string replace with a template placeholder for the footer provenance. f. library.js: compute the excerpt offset on the same string you slice. 3102 (TASK-112) — fix on branch task-…-112-work: a. docs/storage-modes.md:79-83 'New developer setup': add the `aida init` (or `aida node acquire`) step before any spec creation, matching operator-setup.md:17 / README.md:93 / getting-started.md:48. b. docs/cli/10-storage.md:155, docs/storage-modes.md:51, docs/admin-guide.md:231: reword 'auto-rebuilt' / 'stale-check rebuilds automatically' to the bounded-read contract of the chapter intro. c. docs/multi-node.md 'Check identity and routing': restore the per-user queue-file inspection (`ls .aida-store/registry/queues/` or `aida queue list --local --user `) and the concrete fix (pin `export AIDA_USER=` per machine; `--user` for one-offs). 3103 (TASK-113) — bundle on branch task-…-113-work (after merging 112 into it): a. Report reproduction commands use the pinned base 1db74dba1129632c01b5bae9ee5681dd76069db1 and a three-dot diff. b. Swap the severity: onboarding/MCP misstatements Critical-or-Important as appropriate; the broken admin-guide link not above them. c. build.py: move `import sys` to module imports; parse --overview with the existing argument handling. d. Bundled from approved slices: build.py alt text uses the SVG's /<desc> (fixes 3097/3098/3099 generic alt); index.html 'Configure your operating model ↗' wraps the arrow in an aria-hidden span; page-template.html puts {{graphic}} after the h1; docs/showcase/README.md lists every generated page, not only getting-started; docs/configuration-guide.md:11,39 says `aida protocol list` / `aida protocol seed` before `aida protocol show task --lane docs`. Accepted (no change): 14px SVG labels (the SVG scales; readable at mobile width); repo-relative source links (the showcase is published from the repo). Validate: make check-ci-fast (now including build.py --check). Then mail the advisor the new head SHAs of all eight; I will re-review 3096/3101/3102/3103 and ship bottom-up.
subject: Docs stack round-2 ruling (3096-3103)
